arms.name: random_median20
arms.purpose: conservative allocation control receives one additional step and greater cost

aggregation.method: componentwise median of the final 20 parameter states
aggregation.motivation: robust aggregation against large late trajectory spikes that can dominate a mean
aggregation.evaluation: evaluate only the final median with no intermediate checkpoint selection and no decay hyperparameter
aggregation.equal_opportunity: identical snapshot and median rule for low, random, and dense
aggregation.deployment: ordinary dense inference with aggregated weights

cost_accounting.training: same realized-row CPU-calibrated 87.5% FFN sparse-backward formula; dense pays full cost
cost_accounting.snapshot_aux: one parameter-copy operation per model parameter per step for every arm
cost_accounting.median_aux: five estimated comparison operations per parameter per retained state, included in final total

primary_endpoint: final componentwise-median dense held-out loss at training-plus-aggregation cost

decision_rules.allocation_failure: low_max_abs median-tail loss is not below random despite random receiving more steps and cost; stop
decision_rules.no_level_3: low_max_abs beats random but not dense median-tail; stop
decision_rules.development_level_3: low_max_abs median-tail loss is below random and dense while total cost is no greater than either
decision_rules.confirmation: only development_level_3 launches the identical body-7 comparison

prohibited: changing tail length, aggregation method, activity, steps, or evaluation after launch
launching body 7 without a development-level win
